label: Sonata form (textbook model)
text: AR.O.A2.1.4 Sonata form (textbook model). Abstracted from existing works by Reicha (1826), Marx (1845) and Czerny (1848). Koch (1793) described it by modulation. It is an analytic model, not a rule composers followed.

warrant.standard: System defined; instance located in the work
warrant.defeaters: System imposed where the work departs
